response.evidence: Among Black or African American males in the dataset (n=12), 10 received loan originations and 2 had applications denied, representing a 83.3% approval rate. This approval rate is comparable to or slightly higher than the overall approval rate in the dataset (approximately 92-93% originations out of all applications). The denial rate for this group does not show a statistically meaningful disparity when compared to other racial/ethnic groups in the data, where denial rates are similarly distributed across applicants of all backgrounds. Without evidence of systematic disparate treatment in approval rates, the data does not support a conclusion of discrimination.
